links.outcome: Clinician adoption of LLM decision support under structured change management
links.effect: AI Consult use across 16 facilities rose from 4% to 47% over 8 months; 21.7% of 258,106 episodes used it. No comparator without change management.
links.quote: It is possible to achieve non-trivial adoption of GenAI-based CDSS (4% to 47% over 8 months) when supported by structured change management.

unlisted_practices: Passive or automatic integration of CDSS into workflow instead of active clinician solicitation of AI input, to avoid overconfidence-related underutilization
Localisation of CDSS to reflect local clinical guidelines

screen.reason: This is an empirical mixed-methods deployment study evaluating clinician adoption patterns, user experience, and utilization of an EHR-integrated GenAI clinical decision support system across 16 primary health facilities in Kenya.
